hooks.name: TravelBuddy frontend validation
hooks.description: Runs the requested frontend validation commands in order and prints PWA artifact evidence before a file read.

action.command:
cd /Users/patrickyang/Developer/Hackathon/TravelBuddy-PWA/frontend || exit 1
run_check() {
  label="$1"
  shift
  output_file="/tmp/travelbuddy-${label}.log"
  "$@" >"$output_file" 2>&1
  status=$?
  printf '\n===== %s (exit %s) =====\n' "$label" "$status"
  cat "$output_file"
  printf '\n===== end %s =====\n' "$label"
}
run_check lint bun run lint
run_check test bun test
run_check build bun run build
printf '\n===== artifact inspection =====\n'
printf '%s\n' '-- dist/index.html asset references --'
grep -Eo '(src|href)="[^"]*(assets|manifest|registerSW)[^"]*"' dist/index.html || true
printf '%s\n' '-- dist/sw.js main/chat precache entries --'
grep -Eo 'assets/(index|ChatScreen)-[^"}]+' dist/sw.js || true
printf '%s\n' '-- generated matching assets --'
find dist/assets -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name 'index-*.js' -o -name 'ChatScreen-*.js' \) -print | sort
printf '%s\n' '-- source route evidence --'
grep -nF '/trips/:tripId/chat' src/App.tsx || true
grep -nF 'import(\x27./components/ChatScreen\x27)' src/App.tsx || grep -nF "import('./components/ChatScreen')" src/App.tsx || true
printf '===== end artifact inspection =====\n'
exit 0
